name: Scotch Game
description: An active opening that opens the center early and develops pieces quickly.

variations.name: Main Line
variations.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 exd4 4. Nxd4

explanations.e4: Take control of the center and open lines for your pieces.
explanations.Nf3: Develop your knight and attack the e5 pawn.
explanations.Nc6: Black develops a knight and defends the e5 pawn.
explanations.d4: Challenge Black's central pawn immediately. This is the defining idea of the Scotch Game.
explanations.Nxd4: Recapture with your knight, placing it actively in the center.
